a novel dynamic image reconstruction approach for PET is proposed, which uses a spato-temporal prior that not only constrains the neighborhood information, but also voxel's behavior in time to conform the 2-tissue compamental model.
we have developed an efficient and effective method of using spatio-temporal constraints to reconstruct dynamic PET images.
a spatio-temporally prior based kinetic model is proposed for dynamic PET reconstruction and the method is validated using a realistic simulation and real data.

the design of a novel prior model for dynamic PET image reconstruction.
the design of a spatio-temporial model to improve the reconstruction quality of PET dynamic image.
the development of novel spatio-temporal priors for dynamic PET image reconstruction.

the spatio-temporal priors based on 2-tissue kinetic model can be applied to dynamic PET reconstruction to improve the image quality.
this method is a promising tool to provide a more reliable reconstruction of dynamic PET images.
this work is an important contribution to PET dynamic image reconstruction and the proposed method can provide more accurate and robust results than the existing methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new spatio-temporal Bayesian model for dynamic PET reconstruction.
, the prior model we proposed can effectively improve the quality of reconstructed image and the accuracy of kinetic parameter estimation.
the proposed model is a Bayesian framework which combines spatio-temporal priors and the kinetic model of dynamic PET.

the use of a prior that incorporates the kinetic model of tracer uptake and washout is beneficial to the reconstruction of dynamic PET images.
the proposed method can provide a better estimation of the kinetic parameters and a better image reconstruction in dynamic PET.
